channel.title: UFB
channel.description: UFB updates (macOS), for UFB 2.0.3 and later

item.title: Version 2.0.9
item.description:
• The preview's controls sit over the picture. A video or an image sequence now has the whole preview; its controls are on a bar over the foot of the picture, which shows while the pointer moves and fades when it leaves or rests. A sound file keeps the bar in view.
  • Rewind and fast-forward. Two buttons either side of play run through the clip while they are held, as J and L do.

item.title: Version 2.0.8
item.description:
• Image sequences show what is cached. Under the line of a sequence that plays, a band shows the frames held in memory around the one in view, and frames that are missing or cannot be read are marked red.
  • Cache stride. A chip beside the frame rate keeps every frame (1x) or every 2nd to 4th, for renders too heavy to hold whole. It is remembered for each sequence.
  • A job's folders follow its project type's order, After Effects first in the built-in type.
  • 3D renders open their folders. In the renders of a 3D item, a folder that holds a few entries is shown open, its image sequences in view. Settings, General, turns it off.
  • Windows: on a screen that shows HDR, the window is no longer dim.

item.title: Version 2.0.7
item.description:
• Jobs in the sidebar open like folders. A click on a job shows its folder in the pane in front. The job view is asked for by name: Open as Job in the job's menu, or a click with Option (Alt on Windows) held. A click with the middle button, or with Command (Ctrl) held, opens the job view in a new tab, as before.
  • New Web Link… is in the menu of a file or folder too, for a folder with no empty space left to press.
  • A web link's file is shown with a link icon.

item.title: Version 2.0.6
item.description:
• Windows: a share that would not connect (1202). A drive letter that Windows still remembers for another share is no longer chosen for a new one; UFB takes the next free letter.
  • A share that cannot be connected says why in the log.

From 2.0.5:

  • Links you can press. A link in a Links column opens when it is pressed: a web page in the browser, an application's own address in that application. Pressing the rest of the cell edits it, as before.
  • Web links as files. New Web Link… in a folder's menu makes a link file from an address (the clipboard's, when it holds one). Opening a link file opens its address.
  • New minNote… in a folder's menu makes a dated minNotes file and opens it.
  • New UFB Folder…, New Date Folder and New Time Folder are back in a folder's menu.
  • Double-click is a choice. Settings → General: a double click previews a file, or opens it in its application. Space previews either way.

item.title: Version 2.0.4
item.description:
• Layers of an EXR sequence. A sequence whose frames hold several layers gets a layer chip in the preview's playbar: press it and choose the layer to look at. Playing goes on.
  • A share that will not connect can be removed. The other mouse button opens a share's menu wherever on its row it is pressed (the Connect button used to swallow it).
  • Who leads sync can be set in Settings → Sync: Automatic, Prefer this machine, or Never lead (it was only in the Sync entry's menu in the sidebar).

item.title: Version 2.0.3
item.description:
• Check for Updates… is in the UFB menu, under About UFB (it was only in Settings → About).
  • Help → UFB Help opens the manual.

From 2.0.2: a browser view opens with its second pane (Settings → General turns that off); opening UFB again with only the menu-bar icon left brings a window back.

Coming from UFB 1.4? Read Upgrading from 1.4 first.
